{fb:4680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}When do you look after your arms and armor?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}The weapon I use? I just tend to it a little when I have time.{n}{wait}{clear}If anything, I worry more about my medical instruments.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is there a secret to getting better?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}At medicine? {fb:5A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Can you concentrate?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0480}{n}Yes, I was concentrating, but then I had an unexpected visitor.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Who taught you to handle weapons?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}My dagger work? I taught myself.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}House calls to faraway places always come with danger. I needed a way to protect myself.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Thank you, for everything.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Oh, please... There's no need to thank me. I'm only doing what anyone would.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:7880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is there a knack to blending herbs?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}There's no knack as such, but I'd say doing it carefully and precisely.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I simply blend them as best I can, for my patients' sake, so they'll work on the illness.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What did you play when you were little?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}You ask weird stuff, Angel. When I was little? {fb:4680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What do you find most interesting right now?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800380}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}The most interesting thing? Everything's fun, but the MOST...?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I know! Thinking up all kinds of games depending on where I'm playing is the most fun!{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like places where lots of people gather?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800380}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Yeah, I love markets and stuff! They sell all kinds of things, it's so fun!{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:5A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you relaxing?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Yeah! I'm happy I get time to play!{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:6480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like being alone?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}Hmmm. I've hardly ever been alone, so I dunno.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:6E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Please get a good rest.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Okay! Thanks!{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:7880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What kind of crafts do you make most?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Mostly little things. Stuff like brooches, or wooden bowls.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:4680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}When do you look after your arms and armor?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}Hmmm, I don't really do it much. I think Dad told me to keep it up properly, though...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}It's easier than crafts, but maybe I've been kinda sloppy. I'll be careful.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is there a secret to getting better?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}I think it's practicing lots.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}If you throw your boomerang over and over and over, it'll fly where you want and come right back to your hand.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Can you concentrate?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}I'm taking a little break right now. Then I'll focus and practice again.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Who taught you to handle weapons?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}My dad! How to make boomerangs, the knack for throwing them well, Dad taught me all of it.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Thank you, for everything.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800380}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}A-aw, jeez... S-saying that all of a sudden m-makes me embarrassed.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:7880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is it hard to use a boomerang?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Yeah. It's kinda hard till you get the knack.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}But once you're used to it, it's easy.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What did you play when you were little?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}When I was little? That's kind of a weird question. Well, whatever.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}My playmates were dragons and monsters, so I could never beat them at anything. I remember always being so frustrated.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}But I bet the games I played with them were nothing like what human kids play.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:4680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What do you find most interesting right now?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Never really thought about it, but let's see...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}When I catch a whole bunch of fish, maybe?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like places where lots of people gather?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0480}{n}Not really. I feel way more at ease out in nature.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Besides, people can be a pain sometimes...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:5A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you relaxing?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Yeah. But you don't need to worry about me so much.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:6480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like being alone?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}Honestly, not really... But being around people is kinda tough too.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Please get a good rest.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Yeah, thanks. You should take a break once in a while too, {name:0080}.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:7880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Who taught you to fish?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}I saw someone fishing when I went down to the village at the foot of the mountain.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}It looked like fun, so I copied them and gave it a try, and here I am.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:4680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}When do you look after your arms and armor?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}I do it after practice, more or less. It's an important sword, after all... Not that I really want to fight.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is there a secret to getting better?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Well, let's see, keeping up your practice, I guess.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}If you slack off or cut corners, it doesn't do your opponent any good, or you either.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Who taught you to handle weapons?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}The theory came from Aul, and the practice... I just picked it up by watching, I guess...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I've been practicing ever since Aul gave me this sword.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Thank you, for everything.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}N-no, it's nothing like that. I'm just thinking of everyone...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}C-come on, cut it out, it tickles. All this formal thanking.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:4680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What do you find most interesting right now?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Most interesting? Let's see... Going shopping now and then, that's about it.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like places where lots of people gather?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Let's see... Not really.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}But where people gather, you hear news about bounties, and sometimes a job comes along.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:5A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you relaxing?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Yeah, thanks. You sure are considerate, Angel.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:6480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like being alone?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Well, I've gotten used to being alone.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:6E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Please get a good rest.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Yeah, thanks.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:7880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Where do you get word of bounties?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Oh, all over. Requests from the guild, wanted posters stuck up in the square...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}And then there's my own network.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:4680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}When do you look after your arms and armor?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}I take care of 'em properly, after training or after a fight.{n}{wait}{clear}They're the tools of my trade. If anything goes wrong, it's my life on the line.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is there a secret to getting better?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Training, obviously. You can't get good at anything overnight.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Can you concentrate?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}Well, I was concentrating on my training, but now it's on hold.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Who taught you to handle weapons?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Swordsmen in town. I wanted strength so badly that, as a kid, I pestered them into teaching me.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Thank you, for everything.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}What's this all of a sudden?! I'm just doing what I'm supposed to. You're a funny angel.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:7880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I hope peace comes soon.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Yeah, me too. Then I'd be able to relax more and do all kinds of things...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What did you play when you were little?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}When I was little? {fb:4680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What do you find most interesting right now?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800380}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Shopping, of course! {fb:5080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like places where lots of people gather?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}I love places with lots of people. {fb:5A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you relaxing?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Yep. I'm taking it easy. But this isn't the calm before the storm, is it?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like being alone?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}I kinda don't, I guess. I do get lonely sometimes...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}So I'm happy when you drop by now and then, even if you are a stupid angel.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:6E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Please get a good rest.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Yep, thanks.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:4680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}When do you look after your arms and armor?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}It's a pain, so I hardly ever do. Besides, I throw them in battle and they get lost.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is there a secret to getting better?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0480}{n}Keeping at it, I guess. Even if it's a tiiiny bit of a pain.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
